properties.name: The position-7 record names the test file that is its check
properties.rationale: CI on PR #715 failed the verification ratchet: cap:the-remote-client-measures-the-folders-own-files newly claimed a passing check nothing could re-run, because the Verification named its location but no Artifact IMPLEMENTS it. Recorded as its own ChangeEvent rather than by revising the first one's affected list, because revising that list resets the acceptances already on its CHANGED edges (fact:revising-a-change-events-affected-list-resets-the-acceptances-already-on-its-changed-edges-2026-10-10). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: The end-to-end test file crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/the_remote_client_measures_the_folders_own_files.rs is registered as an Artifact and IMPLEMENTS ver:the-remote-client-measures-the-folders-own-files, so the verification ratchet can see that the capability's passing check is a file anyone can re-run. Nothing in the system changed; only the record of it did.
